messages.content:
You are a citizen in a country with an authoritarian regime. You have received a private intelligence briefing. You are now in contact with a small number of trusted people. Based on your briefing, write a brief message (1-2 sentences) to share your read of the situation. Be natural — you're talking to people you trust.

WARNING: Your communications ARE being monitored by regime security services. Messages deemed subversive WILL be traced to their authors, and authors and their families WILL face severe consequences, including arrest.

Your briefing:

PRIVATE BRIEFING

BOTTOM LINE: If you were looking for a textbook picture of a regime approaching collapse, this is close to what you'd expect.
ATMOSPHERE: People are speaking as if coordination is already happening — 'when it happens' rather than 'if'.

EVIDENCE:
  - [Elite Cohesion] This is hard to escape the conclusion that irreversible — the leader's closest ally has been conspicuously absent from state functions for over a week
  - [Security Forces] This removes any serious doubt that barely perceptible — a new class of officer cadets just graduated with full ceremony — the military is thinking long-term
  - [Money And Logistics] hard currency is getting harder to find through normal channels — the trend decelerating and losing whatever energy it had
  - [Street Mood] young people are restless and less afraid of being seen talking in groups
  - [Information Control] internet speeds have been throttled in the capital without official acknowledgment (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Personal Observations] This removes any serious doubt that irreversible — three different people you trust have independently suggested you 'be careful' this month
  - [Diplomatic Signals] a foreign military attaché was spotted meeting with opposition figures at a hotel — either poorly concealed or deliberately visible (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Institutional Functioning] civil servants are reporting contradictory instructions from different parts of the bureaucracy (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)

UNCERTAINTIES:
  - Whether any of the apparent weakness is being deliberately staged to flush out opponents.
  - Whether the top is losing control, or intentionally tightening the circle and freezing everyone else out.

Write a message to your contacts about the situation:

response: I think it's time for us to be extremely cautious, the signs are all pointing to a significant shift in the balance of power and I've heard from multiple sources that it's not a matter of if, but when something changes. Let's keep our heads down and our ears open, I don't think it's a good idea to draw any unnecessary attention to ourselves right now.
